program:
PARAMS = {
    "I_mid":   (80e-6, 30e-6, 200e-6),   # starving current at mid vctrl
    "Ls":      (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),        # starve / mirror length
    "gmid_p":  (8.0, 5.0, 14.0),         # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Wn_inv":  (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),         # ring inverter NMOS width [um]
    "kp":      (2.5, 1.0, 5.0),          # PMOS/NMOS width ratio
    "sfac":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),          # NMOS starve width scale
    "ffrac":   (0.12, 0.03, 0.3),        # floor current fraction of I_mid
    "Lf":      (1.0, 0.3, 3.0),          # floor device length
    "Wb2":     (1.5, 0.42, 4.0),         # output buffer NMOS width [um]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vlo, vhi = spec["vctrl_range"]
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    I = p["I_mid"]; Ls = p["Ls"]
    N = 3

    # starve NMOS (gate = vctrl)
    idw = lut.op("n", 1.0, Ls, vmid, 0.4)["Id"]
    Wns = max(0.42, p["sfac"] * I / idw)
    # floor current NMOS (gate = vdd), always on
    Lf = p["Lf"]
    idwf = lut.op("n", 1.0, Lf, VDD, 0.4)["Id"]
    Wf = max(0.42, p["ffrac"] * I / idwf)
    # PMOS mirror
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Ls, I, vds=1.0)

    Wn = p["Wn_inv"]; Wp = max(0.42, p["kp"] * Wn)
    Li = 0.15
    Wb1n = 0.6; Wb1p = max(0.42, p["kp"] * Wb1n)
    Wb2n = p["Wb2"]; Wb2p = max(0.42, p["kp"] * Wb2n)

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    # reference branch
    n.M("MR", "pb", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wns, Ls)
    n.M("MRF", "pb", "vdd", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wf, Lf)
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)

    nodes = ["r1", "r2", "r3"]
    for i in range(N):
        inp = nodes[i - 1]
        out = nodes[i]
        n.dev(f"MPS{i}", f"sp{i}", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
        n.M(f"MP{i}", out, inp, f"sp{i}", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Li)
        n.M(f"MN{i}", out, inp, f"sn{i}", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Li)
        n.M(f"MNS{i}", f"sn{i}", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wns, Ls)
        n.M(f"MNF{i}", f"sn{i}", "vdd", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wf, Lf)

    # output buffer: two unstarved inverters
    n.M("MB1P", "b1", "r3", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wb1p, Li)
    n.M("MB1N", "b1", "r3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb1n, Li)
    n.M("MB2P", "vout", "b1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wb2p, Li)
    n.M("MB2N", "vout", "b1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb2n, Li)

    # capacitance estimate per ring node
    cgn = lut.op("n", Wn, Li, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]
    cgp = lut.op("p", Wp, Li, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]
    cin = cgn + cgp
    cnode = cin * 1.6
    cb1 = (lut.op("n", Wb1n, Li, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"] + lut.op("p", Wb1p, Li, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"])
    cb2 = (lut.op("n", Wb2n, Li, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"] + lut.op("p", Wb2p, Li, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"])
    csum = N * cnode + cb1
    eff = 0.55  # calibrated from previous sim (0.74 x 0.7, ~load removed)

    If = lut.op("n", Wf, Lf, VDD, 0.4)["Id"]

    def f_at(vc):
        Iv = lut.op("n", Wns, Ls, vc, 0.4)["Id"] + If
        return eff * Iv / (csum * VDD), Iv

    f_lo, _ = f_at(vlo)
    f_mid, Im = f_at(vmid)
    f_hi, _ = f_at(vhi)
    # ring: ref + mirror; buffer: dynamic + ~50% short-circuit
    pbuf = 1.5 * ((cb1 * 1.6 + cb2) * 1.3 + CL + cb1 * 0.6) * VDD**2 * f_mid
    power = 2.0 * Im * VDD + pbuf
    kvco = (f_hi - f_lo) / (vhi - vlo)
    return n, {"f_lo": f_lo, "f_mid": f_mid, "f_hi": f_hi,
               "fmin": f_lo, "fmax": f_hi,
               "tuning_ratio": f_hi / max(f_lo, 1.0),
               "kvco": kvco, "swing": 1.75, "power": power}

events.topology: 3-stage current-starved ring, vctrl directly on NMOS starve devices, PMOS starves mirrored from a vctrl-driven reference branch

events.reason: Swing fails because the ring node drives 10fF; add a full-swing two-stage buffer. f_lo unmeasurable as starve NMOS near threshold at 0.6V; add a VDD-gated floor current in parallel with the starve and
Topology works; power exceeds limit by 5% while f_mid has 2.4x margin. Lower I_mid (and slightly ffrac/Ls) to cut power below 500uW; tuning ratio 3.7 and swing 1.87V retain margin.
